# Message scroller

A scrolling list of messages that keeps the newest in view.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Readers need sections, navigation and little else. It keeps live chat in view, and people here read from start to end. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./pagination">Pagination</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A live conversation where new messages arrive at the bottom.
- **Not when:** A static list (a scroll area).

Instead:

- [Scroll area](./scroll-area.md): A plain scrolling region.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] New messages are announced politely without moving focus. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add message-scroller
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Message scroller reads 5 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Message scroller's tokens to change Message scroller alone.
